'''Star Tours Flight 309''' was the designation of a [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] travel agency flight to [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. On the morning of the [[Raid at Spaceport THX1138]], the flight had landed at the spaceport's Gate 2M in time for its scheduled 0655 hour arrival, and was boarding passengers for its 0750 departure.
